review_mode: Manufacturer documents and independent source review; no measurements

comparator.propagation_conditions: 2.7V and5V tables,CL15pF,20mV and100mV overdrive rows; applicability to continuous supply,chosen commonmode and ramp not established

CMRR_min_dB.temperature_basis: 25C default; do not extend unqualified to fulltemp

comparator.input_clamp: Input diode clamps to supply rails; absolute10mA limit is not an accepted off-state injection budget.

reference.drift_method: BOX over-40..125C; not a pointwise slope bound
reference.supply_slew_note: Section9.2.2.3 warns of slow-input startup/shutdown anomalies and recommends rise/fall slew near6V/ms; this is not an accepted board waveform or guaranteed timing.
reference.sink_load_condition: REF3425 at25C only; no fulltemp extension
reference.startup_condition: To0.1%,10uF output cap; not a maximum
reference.load_gate: Two comparator reference-input currents can source into reference. Fulltemp sinking regulation not bounded; bleeder/load plan unresolved.

rejected_integrated.hysteresis_scaling: Nominal-trip assumption, same screening convention asACT06
rejected_integrated.reason: Overdrive amplitudes outside3.0..3.6V; recovery upper bound below converter upper corner. Nominal2us glitch immunity cannot replace maximum detection.
